inlines.v: IGNI'TE, verb transitive [Latin ignis, fire.] To kindle, or set on fire. 1. More generally, to communicate fire to, or to render luminous or red by heat; as, to ignite charcoal or iron. Anthracite is ignited with more difficulty than bituminous coal. IGNI'TE, verb intransitive To take fire; to become red with heat.
